patch.label: Quick Harusame Slash
patch.description: Fast high sword check with long active coverage at close range.

applied.reason: Short standing sword poke at upper-body height.

patch.label: Low Spirit Slide
patch.description: Fast low sliding sword kick with long active time along the ground.

applied.reason: Body drops into a low horizontal slide that attacks the legs.

patch.label: Amidamaru Body Cut
patch.description: Quick mid sword thrust with a short active window for close confirms.

applied.reason: Compact forward sword strike through the torso line.

patch.label: Heavy Spirit Kick
patch.description: Fast mid kick sequence with very long active coverage before a quick reset.

applied.reason: Standing kick route mixes a raised leg and sword guard at mid height.

patch.label: Kneeling Harusame Ender
patch.description: Slow mid sword cut that knocks down and finishes in a crouched stance.

applied.reason: Downward sword finish visibly settles low and already has knockdown behavior.

patch.label: Amidamaru Cross Launcher
patch.description: Slow mid cross slash launcher with long active sword coverage.

applied.reason: Crossing sword path is authored as a launcher and lifts from the slash sequence.

patch.label: Spirit Crescent Kick
patch.description: Fast mid crescent kick and sword swing with long active coverage.

applied.reason: Arc-shaped mid kick sequence, but not a full spinning tornado reset.

patch.label: Low Harusame Feint
patch.description: Slow low sword feint with a moderate active window for clipping movement.

applied.reason: Forward low slash stays near shin height.

patch.label: Leaping Low Spirit Kick
patch.description: Slow low jumping kick that stays active before knocking the opponent down.

applied.reason: Low entry rises into a hopping kick and is authored as a knockdown.

patch.label: Oversoul Power Crush
patch.description: Slow mid spirit slash with knockdown force and heavy recovery.

applied.reason: Committed purple spirit slash lands as a heavy knockdown ender.

patch.label: Crouch Harusame Rush
patch.description: Fast mid crouch rush with long active sword pressure and quick recovery.

applied.reason: Starts low, then chains into a standing sword rush.

patch.label: Crouch Amidamaru Launcher
patch.description: Slow mid launcher with long active spirit-sword coverage from crouch.

applied.reason: Crouch route brings out a vertical spirit-sword lift and is authored as a launcher.

patch.label: Oversoul Aura Drive
patch.description: Steady special spirit rush with very long active time that knocks down.

applied.reason: Special slot shows a spirit-enhanced forward slash chain into knockdown.

patch.label: Rising Harusame Cut
patch.description: Fast mid while-standing cut with steady active time and controlled recovery.

applied.reason: While-standing route rises into a body-level sword thrust.

patch.label: Rising Spirit Strike
patch.description: Fast mid rising strike with very long active coverage and quick reset.

applied.reason: Rising route uses the repeated forward spirit-slash animation.

patch.label: Diagonal Spirit Launcher
patch.description: Slow mid launcher with a tiny active window and high commitment.

applied.reason: Forward-diagonal thrust is authored as a launcher and visually lifts through the body.

patch.label: Amidamaru Rush
patch.description: Fast mid sword rush with very long active pressure and quick recovery.

applied.reason: Advancing spirit-assisted slashes match Yoh's Amidamaru pressure style.

patch.label: Forward Harusame Cut
patch.description: Fast mid forward cut with steady active time and a compact finish.

applied.reason: Forward command uses the direct mid sword thrust animation.

patch.label: Oversoul Burst Ender
patch.description: Fast mid spirit burst with long active time that knocks down at the end.

applied.reason: Quarter-circle ender flashes into a spirit burst and lands as knockdown.
